Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Hearts of Three", "unit": 10, "heading": "CHAPTER VIII", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "ru78-u010-r0030", "target": "При виде Энрико он уже соскочил с лошади; в знак почтения к Леонсии он держал сомбреро в руке, Энрико протягивал руку в приветствии старинной дружбы, губы его складывались в слова, а глаза выражали восхищение дочерью Энрико.", "source_sha256": "e36a686b6cec225d4d42dedffc6b3b082dd52bbf0282536e9fcb971c255ace09", "target_id": "ru-ru78-u010-r0030", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "3633cfe1f618a5fcc06a56b43511bdb9ef8525fa37c9f6d5a6340ac24f745ac7"}, {"source_id": "ru78-u010-r0031", "target": "Разговор шёл на скороговорке-испанском, и просьба о лошадях была высказана и с оговорками удовлетворена ещё до того, как состоялось знакомство с двумя Морганами. Лошадь асиендадо, на латинский манер, тут же стала лошадью Леонсии, и он без лишних слов укоротил стремена и усадил её в седло. Падёж, объяснил он, выкосил на его плантации всех верховых животных; но у его главного надсмотрщика осталась ещё одна, в сносном состоянии, и она будет принадлежать Энрико, как только её удастся доставить.", "source_sha256": "53af5c781bf590b7d8af3984c5e96a423c0083589686fdc5fdce6f8cf2e0cd47", "target_id": "ru-ru78-u010-r0031", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "05f79a00fdad1dfd24df8385c0af77237d8dbe43b663e63db50f8a6a6e3bd545"}]}, "source_rows": [{"id": "ru78-u010-r0032", "tag": "p", "text": "His handshake to Henry and Francis was hearty as well as dignified, as he took two full minutes ornately to state that any friend of his dear friend Enrico was his friend. When Enrico asked the haciendado about the trails up toward the Cordilleras and mentioned oil, Francis pricked up his ears.", "sha256": "3f7ff61ef7290f7c3cc96aba950b69f6721ab4984c6d8a2e6bc2dc91401f2961", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[762]", "source_html": "

His handshake to Henry and Francis was hearty as well as dignified, as he took two full minutes ornately to state that any friend of his dear friend Enrico was his friend. When Enrico asked the haciendado about the trails up toward the Cordilleras and mentioned oil, Francis pricked up his ears.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u010-r0033", "tag": "p", "text": "“Don’t tell me, Senor,” he began, “that they have located oil in Panama?”", "sha256": "c851d522545e2555eb9e2fd66aa8cb7c1ed638e93882a5bb84cac94552e10c4f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[763]", "source_html": "

“Don’t tell me, Senor,” he began, “that they have located oil in Panama?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u010-r0034", "tag": "p", "text": "“They have,” the haciendado nodded gravely. “We knew of the oil ooze, and had known of it for generations. But it was the Hermosillo Company that sent its Gringo engineers in secretly and then bought up the land. They say it is a great field. But I know nothing of oil myself. They have many wells, and have bored much, and so much oil have they that it is running away over the landscape. They say they cannot choke it entirely down, such is the volume and pressure. What they need is the pipe-line to ocean-carriage, which they have begun to build. In the meantime it flows away down the canyons, an utter loss of incredible proportion.”", "sha256": "76ccf23690bb9440bf68507ac18973f12b26513693fc7347051bb697e5c1323b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[764]", "source_html": "

The haciendado shook his head.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u010-r0037", "tag": "p", "text": "“Transportation,” he explained. “The freight from tide-water to the gushers by mule-back has been prohibitive. They have lakes of oil, great reservoirs in the hollows of the hills, earthen-dammed, and still they cannot choke down the flow, and still the precious substance flows down the canyons.”", "sha256": "fc71e9f8c24d03c8a272c05295a40a3fbd92d4543d6718158dc4ab23ff72725c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[767]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u010-r0038", "tag": "p", "text": "“Have they roofed these reservoirs?” Francis inquired, remembering a disastrous fire in the early days of Tampico Petroleum.", "sha256": "a799cafdafc522c8311f03f20d6b4ec211c617d41e032d851612b599531d3503", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[768]", "source_html": "

“Have they roofed these reservoirs?” Francis inquired, remembering a disastrous fire in the early days of Tampico Petroleum.

“No, Senor.”

Francis shook his head disapprovingly.

“They should be roofed,” he said. “A match from the drunken or revengeful hand of any peon could set the whole works off. It’s poor business, poor business.”

With Leoncia and Enrico mounted, and the gear made fast to the saddles by leather thongs, the cavalcade started, Alesandro and Ricardo clinging each to a stirrup of their father’s saddle and trotting alongside.
